events.description: Large crowd of civilians in direct, sustained physical confrontation with riot police equipped with helmets and shields; pushing, shoving, and attempts to breach police line observed across multiple frames.

Mutual physical combat between individuals in the crowd and police officers: visible grappling, pulling, and forceful contact (e.g., person in orange vest being held/struggled with by multiple officers and civilians at f9–f12).

Sustained violent clash between a dense crowd of civilians and a line of riot police equipped with helmets and shields; multiple individuals are pushed, shoved, and fall to the ground while officers advance and use batons or shields to disperse the crowd.

Mutual physical combat occurs between multiple individuals in the crowd and police officers: civilians grab officers' arms and shields while officers push back forcefully; at least one person is seen being struck and falling during this interval.

A person in a red jacket is on the ground (or crouched low) and appears to be struck or pinned by multiple officers while others in the crowd attempt to intervene; the individual is in a vulnerable position and subjected to force without apparent resistance.

Sustained violent clash between a crowd of civilians and a line of riot police equipped with helmets and shields; officers push forward while protesters resist, some are pushed to the ground, and physical contact is continuous across frames.

Mutual physical combat occurs between individuals in the crowd and police officers: civilians grab, shove, and grapple with officers, while officers use batons and body pressure to disperse; visible in multiple frames where hands are engaged and bodies are locked in struggle.

A person in a red jacket is on the ground or being forcibly subdued by multiple officers while others stand over them; the individual appears unable to resist effectively during this interval, suggesting a helpless victim being subjected to force.

A sustained violent clash between a line of riot police (in full protective gear with shields and helmets, marked 'POLICIA') and a dense crowd of civilians on a city street. The crowd pushes against the police line, some individuals raise arms or objects; police actively push back, advance, and appear to use batons. The confrontation escalates over time, with visible physical contact and attempts to breach the police formation.

Direct physical combat occurs between individual protesters and police officers: in frames f2–f5, a protester in a green hood is seen grappling with an officer, and other officers are engaged in close-quarters shoving and striking with batons against individuals in the front of the crowd.

A distinct episode of mutual physical combat near yellow poles: a man in a red jacket and scarf appears to strike or shove a police officer (f12–f15), while another civilian in brown holds what looks like a baton-like object toward officers; officers respond with defensive/offensive postures and baton use.

Police in riot gear advance and engage with protesters, resulting in physical confrontations, takedowns, and chaotic movement; metal barriers are knocked over and individuals are subdued on the ground.

Multiple officers are seen pinning a person on the ground while others approach; the individual appears restrained and unable to resist, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim during a police intervention.

At least two individuals (one in civilian clothes, one in dark gear) are engaged in close physical struggle on the ground, with others intervening; this constitutes mutual or contested physical combat.

Multiple police officers in riot gear are seen subduing and restraining a person lying on the ground; the individual appears helpless while officers apply force, including kneeling on the torso and holding limbs.

A chaotic street scene with multiple uniformed officers in full riot gear actively engaging individuals, running, and forming groups amid scattered debris and parked scooters; background shows agitated crowd movement and tension consistent with violent unrest.

A black police van is shown with severe front-end damage: shattered windshield, crumpled hood, and visible deformation; the vehicle appears to have collided with an object or another vehicle, as evidenced by the impact damage and its stopped position amidst debris.

A group of people, some wearing orange vests and others with Catalan flags, are actively engaging in violent unrest: they push metal barricades toward a police van, one person is seen on the ground (possibly struck or fallen), and the crowd surges aggressively around the vehicle.

In frame f13, two individuals appear to be engaged in direct physical combat near the center of the crowd, with one raising an arm in a striking motion toward another who is recoiling; this is part of the broader riot but constitutes a distinct mutual physical confrontation.

A group of individuals, many wearing masks and dark clothing, collectively push, topple, and dismantle metal crowd-control barriers in an urban street setting, resulting in a pile of fallen barriers; this constitutes collective violent unrest against property.
An individual lifts and throws a large black wheeled bin (likely a public waste container) toward the pile of downed barriers, contributing to the destructive actions during the unrest.
